context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: おそれ/おん/驚かさ/でん/折角/思い入れ/おもしろく/ひょっとしたら

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、雨で、お祭り、中止になるおそれ、あるかな?
lines.en: Mom, do you think the rain might make them cancel the festival?
lines.style: Small, careful voice. Real worry underneath, but asking gently—like he's checking if it's okay to be concerned. Slight pause before 'rain,' gathering courage to voice the fear.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お友達のひかりちゃんと、翔くん、おんなじ歳ね。
lines.en: That's true. Your friend Hikari is the same age as you, isn't she?
lines.style: Gentle redirection, warm but slightly distracted. The voice of someone answering while thinking of something else—kind, not dismissive. Soft landing on the closing question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 昨日のテストの点数、ぼく、自分でも驚かされたよ!
lines.en: I was surprised by my test score yesterday! Even I didn't expect it.
lines.style: Bright, sudden energy. Pride breaking through carefully—not boastful, just genuinely delighted and eager to share. Quick attack on the opening word, light throughout.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: おでん、お父さんが大好きなのよね、寒い時期、よく作る。
lines.en: Your dad loves oden so much. He makes it all the time when the weather gets cold.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost thinking aloud. The voice of someone remembering a small habit she loves. Gentle, grounded. No hurry in the pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 折角、お祭り、行こうと思ったのに、雨かあ、残念。
lines.en: I really wanted to go to the festival too. It's a shame the rain came.
lines.style: Soft disappointment. Sits with the sadness a moment without dwelling on it. Understanding in her voice—not trying to fix it, just acknowledging his feeling alongside hers. Trailing sigh at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんが作ってくれた絵本、ママも、思い入れがあるのよ。
lines.en: The picture book your grandmother made for you—I have feelings about it too, you know.
lines.style: Tender and thoughtful. Slows down slightly. The voice of someone opening up about something that matters. Honest, not sentimental—a quiet sharing of her own connection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 今日の本、おもしろく読めたよ、ぼく、夢中だった。
lines.en: I got really absorbed in the book today. I read it all without stopping.
lines.style: Bright and genuine excitement. Unguarded delight in being lost in a story. Natural, quick pace. The openness of a child who got exactly what he wanted from a moment.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ひょっとしたら、明日、お父さん、早く帰れるかもよ。
lines.en: Maybe your dad will be able to come home early tomorrow.
lines.style: Gentle possibility offered up softly. A small gift of hope wrapped in uncertainty. Warm, not overly bright—realistic but kind. Trailing off slightly, leaving space for him to hope alongside her.
